msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia naira-aromas-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury beauty campaign still life of a brown and gold perfume bottle with an ornate gold cap and Arabic lettering, with mango slices and white flowers from the reference. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm cinematic light, rich textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia naira-aromas-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a bright yellow perfume bottle with an ornate gold cap from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia naira-aromas-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a round pink perfume bottle shaped like a doughnut with a gold cap, with strawberries from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia naira-aromas-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a pastel iridescent pink and blue perfume bottle with its matching box, among raspberries from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia naira-aromas-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a black perfume bottle with a gold horse emblem and a gold cap from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail.
